fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

digit_sum(value: int, base: int) -> int is
    let remaining mut = value
    let total mut = 0

    while remaining > 0 do
        total = total + remaining % base
        remaining = remaining / base
    od

    total
si

for (value, base) in [(1, 10), (1234, 10), (0xFE, 16), (0xF0E, 16)] do
    write_line("{value} in base {base}: {digit_sum(value, base)}")
od
